text:
nina.cs: Quick sync  Spectral reserved pool cutover scheduled 08:00 PT tomorrow. Need final quota map, autoscale policy signoff, and a concise smoke/soak plan. Who can own verification?

alex.eng: Ill take autoscale + verification. What SLOs and burst headroom did the AE confirm?

nina.cs: Customer SLOs: p95 < 230ms, error < 0.4%. They asked for 20% burst headroom first 30m and explicit rollback steps. Renewal convo in two weeks so we want a clean launch.

rahul.ops: Quota allocations in portal: us-west-1a=46, us-west-1b=34, us-west-1c=20. Commit tag: spectral-2026-04-05. Finance pre-approved +1 replica for up to 30m (approval FN-982).

frank.sre: Suggest starting with policy "soft-roll" (scale_step=1/75s) for first 15m to avoid JIT/GC thrash. Also lower OOM alert thresholds and schedule watch.

alex.eng: Test plan:
- steady: 60% expected QPS for 12m to validate p95 and errors
- burst: 0->100% in 4m, hold 10m, cool 6m to validate burst handling and fallback
Runner: k6 for steady, vegeta for burst. Example:
```bash
k6 run --vus 180 --duration 12m spectral_steady.js --out json=steady.json
```

nina.cs: Capture KV hit-rate, kernel/JIT logs, model-switch latency (if we fallback to q8), and token cost delta. Upload artifacts to S3 and paste link.

runner-bot: Artifact uploaded s3://redwood-ops/spectral/bringup/2300012345/steady.json

alex.eng: Steady results: p95=220ms, errors=0.3%, KV hit-rate=79%, cpu avg 70%. Link: https://s3.aws/redwood/spectral/2300012345/steady-report.zip

alex.eng: Burst run (soft-roll) results: short cold window ~65s, p95 peaked 420ms while a node compiled kernels, then settled to 225ms. artifacts: https://s3.aws/redwood/spectral/2300012345/burst-softroll.zip

alex.eng: Burst run (immediate-burst) results: avoided long cold tail but cpu spiked 94% on a host; p95 peaked 335ms and we saw GC blips. artifacts: https://s3.aws/redwood/spectral/2300012345/burst-burstmode.zip

frank.sre: Notes: warm-replica (+1) eliminates the kernel JIT tail but costs ~11% extra for the warm window. Prefix priming reduces cold-window but sometimes JIT still hits on first kernel invocation. Recommend a priming + soft-roll combo.

rahul.ops: I can enable one-time prefix priming and pre-seed top prefixes before flip. Also prepared temporary slot for +1 replica if we auto-fallback (portal id quota-SP-442).

nina.cs: Tradeoffs: minimize customer-visible spikes for renewal. Recommendation: enable prefix priming, soft-roll autoscale for first 20m. Auto-fallback: spin +1 warm replica if p95>380ms for >60s and route 5% to q8 fallback if needed. Add rollback steps in runbook.

frank.sre: I'll lower OOM thresholds and watch 07:40-08:40 PT. Rollback steps added: revert priming, spin warm replica, enable fallback routing, notify AE & finance. Runbook link: https://confluence.redwood/ops/spectral-bringup

rahul.ops: Priming flag toggled in staging and top prefixes seeded. Runbook updated.

alex.eng: Final verification scheduled 07:30 PT. Will run a short prefix-heavy synthetic to validate priming effectiveness and upload final bundle. Tagging @frank.sre for watch.

runner-bot: Final upload s3://redwood-ops/spectral/bringup/2300012345/final-bundle.tar.gz

nina.cs: Thanks team  I'll update AE + customer with the plan and confirm 09:30 PT post-cutover check-in. Closing loop after final verification.
